Vulnerability Management

Частота сканирования

The rate at which cryptographic assets or PKI-enabled systems are scanned or assessed for vulnerabilities, exposures, or configuration weaknesses as mandated by security policy or compliance frameworks.

Quick answer: The rate at which cryptographic assets or PKI-enabled systems are scanned or assessed for vulnerabilities, exposures, or configuration weaknesses as mandated by security policy or compliance frameworks.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

The rate at which cryptographic assets or PKI-enabled systems are scanned or assessed for vulnerabilities, exposures, or configuration weaknesses as mandated by security policy or compliance frameworks.

Operational example

The scan frequency for critical PKI servers must comply with both organizational policy and regulatory standards such as PCI DSS and NIST.
